statement: Let V = F_2^5. For i = 1,2,3 let F_i be a family of 3-dimensional linear subspaces of V, and suppose dim(U_1 intersection U_2 intersection U_3) >= 1 for every choice U_i in F_i. Then |F_1||F_2||F_3| <= 35^3 = 42875. Equality holds if and only if there is a 1-dimensional subspace L <= V such that, for every i, F_i is the full star of all 3-subspaces containing L.
contribution: A complete exact computer-assisted resolution of the frozen finite instance, including equality classification. The finite domain and lossless GL(5,2) reductions are exhaustively audited, and separate product-bound and non-star-equality CNFs have independently checked binary DRAT refutations. No priority, separate open-status, or broader-parameter claim is made.
